Xiao Wang observes and finds that only 5 students are participating as long jumpers.

[Question]
After observing, how many sprinters does Xiao Wang estimate?

[Candidate Answers]
A. After observing, Xiao Wang estimates there are 26 sprinters.
B. After observing, Xiao Wang estimates there are 25 sprinters.
C. After observing, Xiao Wang estimates there are 39 sprinters.
